calendarNotes: Sarasota County Schools starts the 2025–26 school year for students on Monday, August 11, 2025 and ends the student year on Wednesday, May 27, 2026. The 196-day staff calendar begins August 4, and the last 196-day staff day is May 29. Thanksgiving Break runs November 24–28, Winter Break runs December 22–January 2 with a January 5 professional day before students return January 6, and Spring Break runs March 16–20. The official calendar also lists high school early release dates on December 18–19 and May 26–27 and notes that inclement weather makeup days may be used if needed.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Sarasota County school start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day for Sarasota County Schools is Monday, August 11, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Sarasota County in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Wednesday, May 27, 2026. The calendar lists May 29 as the last day for 196-day staff.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Sarasota County Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 16 through Friday, March 20, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Sarasota County Schools in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 22, 2025 through Friday, January 2, 2026. January 5 is a professional day, so students do not attend school. Students return Tuesday, January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Thanksgiving Break for Sarasota County Schools in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Thanksgiving Break for students and 186-, 196-, and 220-day staff runs Monday, November 24 through Friday, November 28, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Sarasota County Schools have high school early release days in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official calendar lists high school early release on December 18–19, 2025 and May 26–27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: What professional days are listed on the Sarasota 2025–26 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists professional days for students and 186-day staff on October 13, 2025, January 5, 2026, and March 23, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Sarasota County use the same calendar for all schools?
calendarFaqs.a: The district calendar applies to districtwide dates such as holidays, breaks, and professional days. Individual schools may publish separate calendars for athletics, testing, performances, graduation, and campus events.

calendarFaqs.q: Which professional days, mini breaks, and high school early release dates fall outside the major breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: Students are also off on October 13, 2025, and January 5, March 23, and April 3, 2026. High schools also have early release on December 18–19, 2025 and May 26–27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the Sarasota County Schools 2025–26 calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the PDF download button on this page or the official Sarasota County Schools calendar source linked above. MySchoolDates also provides a one-time ICS calendar file for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Outlook.

calendarFaqs.q: Can Sarasota County Schools change dates after weather closures?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The district calendar notes that makeup days may be used after weather-related closures. Check district announcements before relying on late-year dates.
